question_registry.label: 年龄

question_registry.wording_en: What is your gender?

question_registry.label: 常住地区
question_registry.wording_zh: 您目前常住的地区是？
question_registry.wording_en: In which region do you currently live?

question_registry.label: 城市级别
question_registry.wording_zh: 您目前常住城市的级别是？
question_registry.wording_en: What is the city tier of the city where you currently live?

question_registry.label: 个人月收入
question_registry.wording_zh: 您的个人月收入是？
question_registry.wording_en: What is your personal monthly income?

question_registry.label: 零食购买经历
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去3个月，您是否亲自购买过任何预包装零食？
question_registry.wording_en: In the past 3 months, have you personally purchased any pre-packaged snacks?

question_registry.label: 家庭购买角色
question_registry.wording_zh: 您在家庭零食购买决策中通常承担什么角色？
question_registry.wording_en: What role do you usually play in household snack purchase decisions?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: S6=1时出示；否则跳至S8。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if S6=1; otherwise skip to S8

question_registry.label: 近期同类调研
question_registry.wording_zh: 请问您在过去6个月中接受过以下类型的市场调研吗？
question_registry.wording_en: Which of the following types of market research have you participated in during the past 6 months?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-3随机；选中1或2时终止访问；99固定置底，与其他选项互斥。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Randomize codes 1-3; terminate if code 1 or 2 is selected; code 99 fixed at bottom and exclusive

question_registry.label: 相关行业排除
question_registry.wording_zh: 请问您本人或您的家人有在以下行业从事工作的吗？
question_registry.wording_en: Do you or any member of your family work in any of the following industries?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-4随机；选中1-4中任一项时终止访问；99固定置底，与其他选项互斥。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Randomize codes 1-4; terminate if any code 1-4 is selected; code 99 fixed at bottom and exclusive

question_registry.label: 购买品类
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去3个月，您购买过以下哪些零食品类？
question_registry.wording_en: Which of the following snack categories have you purchased in the past 3 months?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 99固定置底，与其他选项互斥。

question_registry.label: 购买频次
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去3个月，您通常每月购买膨化食品多少次？
question_registry.wording_en: In the past 3 months, how many times per month did you usually purchase puffed snacks?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示

question_registry.label: 月度支出
question_registry.wording_zh: 您最近一个月购买膨化食品的总支出约为多少？
question_registry.wording_en: Approximately how much did you spend on puffed snacks in the most recent month?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示

question_registry.label: 购买渠道
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去3个月，您通过哪些渠道购买过膨化食品？
question_registry.wording_en: Through which channels have you purchased puffed snacks in the past 3 months?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；选项1-5随机。

question_registry.label: 主要渠道
question_registry.wording_zh: 您购买膨化食品最主要的渠道是？
question_registry.wording_en: What is your main channel for purchasing puffed snacks?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；选项1-5随机。

question_registry.label: 食用场景
question_registry.wording_zh: 您通常在什么场景食用膨化食品？
question_registry.wording_en: In which situations do you usually eat puffed snacks?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；选项1-5随机。

question_registry.label: 选择因素重要性
question_registry.wording_zh: 选择膨化食品时，以下因素对您有多重要？
question_registry.wording_en: How important are the following factors when you choose puffed snacks?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 题项1-6随机；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 当前满足度
question_registry.wording_zh: 现有膨化食品在健康负担、配料透明和规格便利方面满足您的程度如何？
question_registry.wording_en: How well do current puffed snacks meet your needs in terms of health burden, ingredient transparency and pack convenience?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 题项1-3随机；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 逐价购买考虑
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于70g袋装膨化食品，在以下价格下您是否会考虑购买？
question_registry.wording_en: Would you consider purchasing a 70g bag of puffed snacks at each of the following prices?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 按价格由低到高逐一询问；任一价格选择2时，后续更高价格自动记为2并结束本题。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask prices in ascending order from code 1 to 4; once code 2 is selected, auto-code all higher prices as code 2 and end the question

question_registry.label: 新品概念评价
question_registry.wording_zh: 请评价一款70g可重复封口、轻油咸香的膨化食品概念。
question_registry.wording_en: Please evaluate a concept for a 70g, resealable, lightly oiled savoury puffed snack.
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 题项1-3顺序固定；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 未来购买意向
question_registry.wording_zh: 未来1个月，您购买膨化食品的可能性有多大？
question_registry.wording_en: How likely are you to purchase puffed snacks in the next month?

question_registry.label: 产品方案选择
question_registry.wording_zh: 在方案A、方案B和均不选择之间做出选择。
question_registry.wording_en: Please choose between Product A, Product B and Neither.
question_registry.base: 全部有效被访者；每人8题
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 循环出示8组；每组方案A/B左右随机；3“均不选择”固定；方案属性按DCE设计文件导入。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Show 8 tasks per respondent; randomize Product A/B left-right; keep code 3 fixed; import attributes from the DCE design file

question_registry.label: 购买品牌
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去3个月，您购买过哪些膨化食品品牌？
question_registry.wording_en: Which brands of puffed snacks have you purchased in the past 3 months?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；选项1-5随机；98/99固定置底；99与其他选项互斥。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if Q1=1; randomize codes 1-5; keep codes 98/99 fixed at bottom; code 99 is exclusive

question_registry.label: 最近购买品牌
question_registry.wording_zh: 您最近一次购买的是哪个品牌？
question_registry.wording_en: Which brand did you purchase most recently?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q12选中1-5或98时出示；过录Q12已选品牌并保留原Code；仅选中1个品牌时自动过录；99固定置底。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if Q12=1-5/98; pipe selected brands from Q12 and retain their original codes; auto-code when only one brand is selected; code 99 fixed at bottom

question_registry.label: 最近购买考虑因素
question_registry.wording_zh: 最近一次购买时，您最主要考虑了哪些因素？
question_registry.wording_en: What were the main factors you considered for your most recent purchase?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；选项1-9随机；最多选择3项。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if Q1=1; randomize codes 1-9; select up to 3

question_registry.label: 购买计划性
question_registry.wording_zh: 最近一次购买更接近以下哪种情况？
question_registry.wording_en: Which of the following best describes your most recent purchase?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示

question_registry.label: 再次购买意向
question_registry.wording_zh: 最近一次购买后，您再次购买同一产品的可能性有多大？
question_registry.wording_en: After your most recent purchase, how likely are you to purchase the same product again?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；code4-5计算T2B
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if Q1=1; codes 4-5 form T2B

question_registry.label: 包装规格
question_registry.wording_zh: 您通常购买哪些包装规格？
question_registry.wording_en: Which pack sizes do you usually purchase?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示

question_registry.label: 产品表达吸引力
question_registry.wording_zh: 以下产品表达会在多大程度上提高您的购买兴趣？
question_registry.wording_en: To what extent would each of the following product claims increase your interest in purchasing?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 题项1-6随机；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 购买阻碍
question_registry.wording_zh: 您不购买或减少购买膨化食品的主要原因是什么？
question_registry.wording_en: What are the main reasons you do not purchase or reduce your purchase of puffed snacks?
question_registry.base: Q1未选择膨化食品或Q2低频
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1≠1，或Q1=1且Q2=0-1时出示；选项1-7随机；98固定置底。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask if Q1≠1 or (Q1=1 & Q2=0-1); randomize codes 1-7; code 98 fixed at bottom

question_registry.label: 现有产品体验
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于您最常购买的膨化食品，以下体验表现如何？
question_registry.wording_en: How does the puffed snack you purchase most often perform on the following aspects?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；题项1-6随机；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 优先改善方向
question_registry.wording_zh: 您最希望下一款膨化食品优先改善什么？
question_registry.wording_en: What should the next puffed-snack product improve first?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-7随机。

question_registry.label: 最低可信价格
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于70g袋装膨化食品，低于什么价格会让您开始怀疑产品质量？
question_registry.wording_en: For a 70g bag of puffed snacks, below what price would you begin to doubt its quality?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 仅允许输入1-50的数值；超出范围时提示并停留在本题。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Numeric range 1-50; do not continue if outside range

question_registry.label: 便宜价格
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于70g袋装膨化食品，什么价格是便宜但质量仍可接受？
question_registry.wording_en: For a 70g bag of puffed snacks, what price would you consider inexpensive while still acceptable in quality?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 仅允许输入1-50的数值；Q23≥Q22；不满足时提示并停留在本题。

question_registry.label: 偏贵价格
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于70g袋装膨化食品，什么价格开始显得贵但仍可能购买？
question_registry.wording_en: For a 70g bag of puffed snacks, at what price would it begin to feel expensive but you might still consider purchasing it?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 仅允许输入1-50的数值；Q24≥Q23；不满足时提示并停留在本题。

question_registry.label: 过高价格
question_registry.wording_zh: 对于70g袋装膨化食品，高于什么价格会贵到不再考虑购买？
question_registry.wording_en: For a 70g bag of puffed snacks, above what price would it be too expensive for you to consider purchasing?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 仅允许输入1-50的数值；Q25≥Q24；不满足时提示并停留在本题。

question_registry.label: 货架位置影响
question_registry.wording_zh: 在购买零食时，以下货架位置通常有多大影响？
question_registry.wording_en: When purchasing snacks, how much influence do the following shelf positions usually have?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: Q1=1时出示；题项1-6随机；量表选项顺序固定。

question_registry.label: 新品陈列信息
question_registry.wording_zh: 看到新品陈列时，哪些信息最能推动您进一步查看？
question_registry.wording_en: When you see a new-product display, which information is most likely to make you look more closely?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-8随机；最多选择3项。

question_registry.label: 新品触点
question_registry.wording_zh: 过去4周，您在哪里看到过零食新品或相关内容？
question_registry.wording_en: Where have you seen new snack products or related content in the past 4 weeks?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-6随机；99固定置底，与其他选项互斥。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Randomize codes 1-6; code 99 fixed at bottom and exclusive

question_registry.label: 新品信任内容
question_registry.wording_zh: 哪类内容最容易让您相信一款零食新品值得尝试？
question_registry.wording_en: Which type of content is most likely to convince you that a new snack product is worth trying?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 选项1-7随机。

question_registry.label: 教育程度
question_registry.wording_zh: 您的最高受教育程度是？
question_registry.wording_en: What is the highest level of education you have completed?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask at the end of the questionnaire

question_registry.label: 职业状态
question_registry.wording_zh: 您目前的职业状态是？
question_registry.wording_en: What is your current employment status?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示；选项1-6随机；98固定置底。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask at the end; randomize codes 1-6; code 98 fixed at bottom

question_registry.label: 家庭人口
question_registry.wording_zh: 您的家庭常住人口数是？
question_registry.wording_en: How many people usually live in your household?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask at the end of the questionnaire

question_registry.label: 未成年家庭成员

question_registry.wording_en: Does your household include any children or teenagers under the age of 18?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示；99固定置底，与其他选项互斥。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask at the end; code 99 is exclusive

question_registry.label: 家庭月收入
question_registry.wording_zh: 您的家庭月收入大约是？
question_registry.wording_en: Approximately what is your household's monthly income?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示；99固定置底；非必答。
question_registry.programmer_logic_en: Ask at the end; code 99 fixed at bottom; response optional

question_registry.label: 理想产品改善
question_registry.wording_zh: 理想的膨化食品还应改善什么？
question_registry.wording_en: What else should an ideal puffed snack improve?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 非必答。

question_registry.label: 品牌单项改变
question_registry.wording_zh: 如果可以让零食品牌只做一项改变，您最希望改变什么？为什么？
question_registry.wording_en: If a snack brand could make only one change, what would you most want it to change, and why?
question_registry.programmer_logic_zh: 问卷末尾出示；非必答。

method_references.name: Feast
method_references.adopted_principle: 历史训练特征与线上读取分离；用同一特征定义避免训练和使用口径漂移

method_references.name: MetricFlow
method_references.adopted_principle: 指标定义可执行、可版本化，并把维度、时间粒度和计算口径固定下来

method_references.name: DataHub
method_references.adopted_principle: 用元数据与血缘连接来源、题目、指标、模型和交付结果

method_references.name: MLflow
method_references.adopted_principle: 每次模型训练保留输入版本、样本切分、评估结果和模型状态

method_references.name: PyMC hierarchical partial pooling
method_references.adopted_principle: 小样本项目从上层总体获得稳定先验，同时保留项目和市场差异

method_references.name: YouGov Profiles
method_references.adopted_principle: 持续更新通用画像，支持多维筛选、再访问和客户数据连接

method_references.name: GWI Core
method_references.adopted_principle: 跨市场保持同题同口径，并将定制研究与通用画像连接

method_references.name: NIQ Market Measurement
method_references.adopted_principle: 消费者意向与零售、渠道、商品和经营结果分层连接，而不是互相替代

method_references.name: Ipsos Synthesio
method_references.adopted_principle: 问卷、社媒与行为信号并列验证；非结构化信号进入独立证据层

method_references.name: SDMx
method_references.adopted_principle: 统计数据与其结构元数据共同交换，避免脱离定义传播单一数值

promotion_gates: 跨人群和跨市场测量等值性通过
